name: clip1
text: A dark battlefield plain at dusk in winter, cold wind blowing dry grass hard, snow flurries swirling, low clouds racing, the camera pushing forward. Cinematic realistic look, no people, no text, no logos, no buildings, no modern objects.

name: clip2
text: Many candle flames flickering in total darkness, close-up, wax dripping, thin smoke curling upward, the camera slowly circling. Cinematic realistic look, no people, no text, no letters, no writing, no paper, no buildings, no rooms, no modern objects.

name: clip3
text: Ink and brush on rice paper: black ink spreading and bleeding across the paper in swirls, close-up, the camera gliding sideways. Cinematic realistic look, no people, no text, no logos, no buildings, no modern objects.

name: clip4
text: Winter mountains with storm clouds racing over the ridges, wind blowing snow off the peaks, light breaking through, the camera pulling back. Cinematic realistic look, no people, no text, no logos, no buildings, no modern objects.
